commit_message:
fix(ci): don't let live demoanaf.ro test dependencies block scraping

Propagated from the Brewtality-3-16 template (commit 47b796b). tests/unit/demoanaf.test.js and tests/integration/workflow.test.js call anaf.searchCompany() live and unmocked; without continue-on-error on any pre/post-scrape test step, a demoanaf.ro outage (both it and the cuifirma.ro fallback) could silently stop this scraper from ever running -- exactly what happened to sebiboga/sennder-bucharest-srl-nodejs-scraper on 2026-09-24. Made the pre-scrape unit, pre-scrape integration, and post-scrape E2E steps continue-on-error: true; test results are still generated and uploaded as before.
